S0: Mixed-use district - general mix of residential, commercial, and institutional uses.
S1: Mixed-use district - primarily residential with limited commercial use.
S2: Mixed-use district - medium-intensity blend of uses.
S3: Mixed-use district - higher-intensity blend, typically near centers or corridors.
S5: Mixed-use district - specialized or contextual mixed-use area.
R-.8: Residential district - general residential use with limited floor area ratio (FAR 0.8).
H-1: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, moderate height/density.
H-1-50: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, 50-foot height limit.
H-2: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, medium height/density.
H-2-65: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, 65-foot height limit.
H-3: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, higher-density residential.
H-3-65: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, 65-foot height limit.
H-4: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, high-density residential.
H-5: Residential district - apartment house subdistrict, very high density or high-rise.
L-.5: Local business district - small-scale neighborhood commercial (FAR 0.5).
L-1: Local business district - neighborhood retail/service businesses.
L-2: Local business district - general local commercial use.
L-2-65: Local business district - local business with 65-foot height limit.
B-1: General business district - small-scale, primarily local commerce.
B-2: General business district - neighborhood business area with broader retail/service uses.
B-3-65: General business district - moderate intensity, 65-foot height limit.
B-4: General business district - medium intensity general business.
B-6-90a: General business district - central commercial core, 90-foot height (variant a).
B-6-90b: General business district - central commercial core, 90-foot height (variant b).
B-8-120a: General business district - high-intensity commercial, 120-foot limit (variant a).
B-8-120b: General business district - high-intensity commercial, 120-foot limit (variant b).
B-8-120c: General business district - high-intensity commercial, 120-foot limit (variant c).
B-8: General business district - central commercial area, high intensity.
B-10: General business district - major commercial core or downtown-scale intensity.
M-1: Manufacturing district - light industrial uses, limited environmental impact.
M-2: Manufacturing district - general industrial uses, moderate intensity.
M-8: Manufacturing district - specialized heavy industrial area.
I-2: Industrial district - general industrial and distribution uses.
MER-2: Maritime Economy Reserve district - waterfront and maritime industrial uses.
OS: Open Space district - preserves open areas and recreational land.
OS-G: Open Space - general community open space.
OS-P: Open Space - public parks and playgrounds.
OS-RC: Open Space - recreation and cultural facilities.
OS-SL: Open Space - shoreline access and waterfront buffers.
OS-S: Open Space - scenic or natural preservation.
OS-UP: Open Space - urban plaza or public space.
OS-UW: Open Space - urban wild or natural landscape.
D: Planned Development Area (PDA) overlay or modifier.
U: Urban Renewal Area overlay or modifier.
E: Adult Entertainment overlay or district modifier.
GBD: Green Buildings and Net Zero Carbon Overlay (Article 37).
